name: Are off-market waterfront homes more expensive or cheaper?

mainEntity.name: Are off-market waterfront homes more expensive or cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: The price of off-market waterfront homes can vary widely; they are not inherently more expensive or cheaper than listed properties. Sometimes, a seller may price an off-market home for a quick, discreet sale, potentially leading to a competitive deal. Other times, the exclusivity or unique nature of the property might command a premium. The valuation often depends on the urgency of the seller and the specific market conditions in areas like Boca Raton or Key Biscayne.
acceptedAnswer.description: Off-market waterfront homes are not consistently cheaper or more expensive. Pricing depends on seller motivation, exclusivity, and market conditions.
